key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon densities of states from atomic structures while enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond spectral predictions could accelerate screening for electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic properties while reducing reliance on costly DFT calculations.
method: Decode spectra using atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra through learned continuity-equation transport.
Recover element-resolved contributions without direct supervision.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the best accuracy across all evaluated metrics for both spectrum types and a prospective screen of 8,106 materials validated by new DFT calculations, with 25 of the top 50 candidates confirmed to have valence-band gaps.
watch_item: Physical constraints do not guarantee accurate spectra for unfamiliar materials; high-value screening candidates still warrant DFT or experimental validation.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
